scientific_question: Does the already qualified 16-node real-HeadCalc state library contain two strict accepted origins with the same total profile water and same upper-30-cm water but a materially different distribution within the deeper 30-160 cm profile?
rationale: E02 established a fixed-Hc response difference for equal total profile water but different vertical distribution.
E03 through E03C failed to isolate deeper distribution while also matching upper-30-cm storage, and the scalar rate-tuning route is now closed.
Before constructing additional forcing histories, reuse existing immutable strict state evidence and target the unresolved deeper 30-160 cm distribution directly.
Because W_profile and W_root30 are both gated, deep storage W_30_160 is also effectively gated; a deep centroid then tests distribution within that storage rather than its amount.
source_authority: Only O2 state files from named qualified artifacts are parsed; each source workflow already qualified complete O0/O2 observable identity.
Artifact id, name, digest and expiry state must be verified before selection.
Only node-level committed H/theta plus minimal provenance needed to identify a state may enter the census.
Any source-level W, M1, ROOT30, exchange, terminal flux, tangent, nonlinear diagnostics or response quantities are ignored and recomputed or excluded.

frozen_pair_gate.distinct_state_requirement: different immutable provenance keys and non-bit-identical H/theta vectors

selection.candidate_pool: union of all strict committed state records recoverable from the five named immutable artifacts
selection.deduplication: bit-identical H/theta states are collapsed deterministically to the lexicographically first provenance key
ranking: smallest abs(delta root-zone centroid) as diagnostic tie-breaker only
selection.no_match: Close E03D NO_MATCH without changing source set, storage tolerances or deep-centroid threshold.

response_firewall: no fixed-Hc response data are downloaded beyond what may coexist in source artifacts
parser must ignore any line not required to reconstruct state provenance and H/theta
no response, exchange, terminal-flux or tangent field may influence pair construction or ranking
selected pair, if any, must be persisted with all 16 H/theta values before any response experiment
next_if_selected: GC-RZM06E04 preregisters common-time reconstruction of the immutable E03D pair and an identical forcing-free fixed-Hc response probe with W_profile and W_root30 gates enforced.
controls: no new physical state generation in E03D
nonclaims: A selected E03D pair would establish only state-space availability, not response-memory causality.
The deep centroid is a bounded research observable for the C01 16-node carrier, not a universal production state variable.
No production coupling admission follows from the census.
